items.title: Diaries of a Primitive Man
items.summary: John Yau on Roy Lichtenstein, Megan O’Grady on John Berger, and Paddy Johnson answers the question: Do I need an agent?

items.title: Cannupa Hanska Luger’s Truth About America
items.summary: The beauty of the Native artist’s forms seduces, but the visual history of destruction is embedded into each element.

items.title: Artavazd Pelechian’s Distant Connections
items.summary: Through his “distance montage” technique, the Armenian filmmaker’s masterpieces are built around impressions, not stories.

items.title: Tanya Merrill's Animal Instinct
items.summary: After a move upstate and a newborn, Merrill’s new work responds to the world around her.
